title: Herbs of Life
description: A recreation of Spice of Life for Spigot servers.
body:
A simple plugin meant to recreate Spice of Life somewhat on servers.

Using your last foods eaten (10 by default) it calculates a multiplier. If you eat Pumpkin Pies for example, with a max food history of 10, your last pie consumed will only give you 1 nutrition instead of the 8 it usually gives.

Herbs of life also provides a positive reinforcement for eating a variety of foods. You can set a configurable max health boost to apply to a player whenever they eat a new food.

All default food values are configurable.
